model: Zeppelin Mk. IV Titanium Road Frame Set (Rim Brake)
description:
First introduced in the late 1990s, the original Zeppelin established a reputation as one of the finest titanium road bicycles of its time. Among the earliest direct-to-consumer titanium frames, it was admired for its refined ride quality, compliance, and exceptional durability — qualities that continue to be appreciated by discerning riders today.

The Zeppelin Mk. IV revives this heritage with deliberate refinement. Built around the same front triangle as the Mk. V and featuring near-identical geometry, it is equipped for riders who value the precision and feedback of a classic rim-brake platform.

Key features:

Direct-mount rim brakes front and rear — powerful stopping with superior modulation and tactile control

Clearance for up to 30 mm tires (Direct mount brake clearance limitation) — balanced comfort and road versatility.

Quick-release 3D CNC dropouts reliable, traditional aesthetics.

Premium double-butted 3Al-2.5V titanium tubing construction — natural compliance, superior vibration damping, and lifetime durability.

Advanced hydroformed titanium T/T and D/T — precisely engineered shapes for superior stiffness where you need it, compliance where you want it, and a strikingly modern, aggressive aesthetic.

Modern endurance-oriented geometry — composed handling, efficient power transfer, and all-day comfort

For riders who appreciate the purity and direct connection of a rim-brake road machine, the Mk. IV delivers a considered, timeless expression of titanium craftsmanship.
